name: kova-app-container
description: Container for running Claude Agent SDK and dev server for Kova apps

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/data-platform/metadata/sources dist/data-platform/metadata/dbt && cp -r data-platform/metadata/sources/*.yaml dist/data-platform/metadata/sources/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r data-platform/metadata/dbt/* dist/data-platform/metadata/dbt/ 2>/dev/null || true
